binding_contract.verification: Read exact captured bytes once, verify external digest and byte count before parsing or compiling; recheck preserved files after execution.
binding_contract.record_seal: SHA256 of sorted compact UTF8 JSON excluding only content_sha256; no newline in the hashed payload.

fixed_design.contexts: All exact prepared contexts are none_required with empty text and bindings.
fixed_design.decoder_selection: Retained native768 selected400 checkpoint for each registered seed; no new selection or fitting.
fixed_design.ae_selection: Expanded TRAIN32 update200 checkpoint matching decoder seed; this is a paired seed design, not a full AE-seed by decoder-seed factorial.
fixed_design.representation_fit: None in this downstream continuation. Use saved TRAIN32-only PCA control and saved selected AEs from the completed expanded run.

raw.recipe: Exact original native768 producer coordinates joined by source/input identity; float32 conversion is confined to numerical decoder input.
raw.training_basis: Existing pinned Alibaba multilingual GTE native producer profile.

pca_reconstructed.recipe: Saved TRAIN32-only mean/global RMS, retained31 PCA axes and inverse projection, then inverse normalization into768 source coordinates.
pca_reconstructed.profile_label: Derived PCA reconstruction; never relabel as an observed native backbone output.

ae_reconstructed.recipe: Saved same-seed selected update200 expanded AE reconstruction, inversely normalized into768 source coordinates.
ae_reconstructed.profile_label: Derived AE reconstruction; never relabel as an observed native backbone output.

disabled.recipe: Exact raw768 input with decoder latent conditioning disabled through the owner's disabled control.

zero.recipe: 768 float32 zero coordinates with latent conditioning enabled.

rotate_raw.recipe: For each32-row split in its immutable cohort order, donate the next raw768 vector cyclically; perform donation before source preflight or decoder eligibility filtering.

request_contract.source_text: Exact prepared source_text, without grammar repair, truncation or case normalization.
request_contract.source_preflight: Existing pinned canonical decoder preflight, computed from source and declared context only.
request_contract.filtering: Compute all transformations and all donors for the complete64-request panel before filtering; return every input in original order.
request_contract.zero_eligible_rows: Valid observed outcome. Persist every blocked request, record zero decoder forwards and avoid inventing generation success.

measurable_outcomes.decoder_proposal_authority: Existing wrapper outcome decoder_proposal means an unaccepted structural proposal; accepted remains false.
conditioning_sensitivity: proposal bytes equal to same-seed raw
proposal bytes equal to same-seed disabled
finite decision-margin changes on common eligible rows
not_measured: independently judged obligation or permission preservation

reporting_contract.denominators: Report64 all requests per arm plus separate32 TRAIN and32 DEV outcomes; eligibility denominators remain supplementary.
reporting_contract.deterministic_controls: Raw and PCA input representations are deterministic controls shared across decoder seeds; three decoder outputs are different seeded models, not independent representation fits.
reporting_contract.paired_ae_limitation: Same seed index pairs AE and decoder randomness. Results do not isolate AE-seed variance from decoder-seed variance.
reporting_contract.interpretation: This perturbation experiment tests whether a retained raw-trained decoder changes under reconstruction. It does not compare newly trained PCA-conditioned versus AE-conditioned decoders or establish which representation autoformalizes law better.
reporting_contract.supported_lane_scope: native768 only. Retained trained384 decoder uses a different learned legal-IR profile, and no compatible8D span decoder was established.
reporting_contract.weights: No new model weights are generated by this inference-only slice.

next_matched_training_design.prerequisite: Separately admit exact TRAIN formal targets under an explicit reviewed or weak-diagnostic row-bound policy; do not change the current source-only masks by inference.
next_matched_training_design.minimal_architecture: Use identical source-token encoder, formula decoder,768-dimensional conditioning adapter, initial source weights, parameter count, vocabulary, optimizer schedule and decoding limits across raw/PCA-reconstructed/AE-reconstructed arms.
next_matched_training_design.source_text_control: Include the same source text in all arms and a source-only disabled arm, since text may dominate the conditioning vector.
next_matched_training_design.fit_boundaries: Fit PCA, AE and normalization on TRAIN sources only; freeze representation transforms before opening DEV targets; fit every decoder on the same admitted TRAIN targets.
next_matched_training_design.budget: Prespecify identical completed optimizer-update counts and batch schedules; retain zero-step and final states, all seeds and all-request outcomes. Never select a representation on these already exposed DEV32 sources as if they were confirmation data.
next_matched_training_design.latent_only_comparison: Lower-dimensional latent conditioning requires a new versioned adapter. Match effective bottleneck width or separately report capacity as a changed factor; equal widths cannot be silently imposed on the existing4/32/64 AE latents and4/31/31 PCA coordinates.
next_matched_training_design.reviewed_confirmation: A new traceably grouped independently reviewed corpus is required for semantic conclusions, with training, tuning and untouched confirmation roles declared before fitting.

design_validation.prior_weak_manifest_read_scope: Top-level keys, first-row key names, ID/group identity and masks only; no proposal/canonical target bodies.
